test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: On which of the following crops, is the Indian Government specially focussing this year?
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Millets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Government is specially focusing on millets this year, as mentioned in the **last paragraph** of the passage:

 
 
• *"The United Nations General Assembly has declared the year 2023 as the International Year of Millets and** India is at the forefront in celebrating the event in a big way.** In order to create awareness about the benefits of millets as superfood and to meet its growing demand around the world,** the Government is promoting millet production** through the NFSM-Nutri Cereals component of National Food Security Mission programme in 212 districts of 14 states."*
 
 
 
• Therefore,** option 4, millets**, is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1,** rice, is incorrect because although the area under rice has increased, there is no mention in the passage of any special focus or promotion by the Indian Government on rice production this year.
 
• **Option 2, **oilseeds, is also incorrect because although there has been an increase in area under oilseeds, there is no mention in the passage of any special focus or promotion by the Indian Government on oilseed production this year.
 
• **Option 3,** pulses, is also incorrect because although there has been an increase in area under pulses, there is no mention in the passage of any special focus or promotion by the Indian Government on pulse production this year.
